whyItMatters: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads an `allowedVersions` range that admits pre-releases.
actions: Pin the declaration to an exact version or to the narrowest range the project tests, and update it deliberately. Specifically: fix an `allowedVersions` range that admits pre-releases.
verification: Re-run the dependency scan and confirm packages.config no longer carries an `allowedVersions` range that admits pre-releases.
